The Present Situation Index—based on consumers' assessment of current business and labor market conditions—retreated by 7.9 points to 109.3. The Expectations Index—based on consumers' short-term outlook for income, business, and labor market conditions—fell by 5.9 points to 63.6, its third consecutive monthly decline. Initial claims for state unemployment benefits slipped 1,000 to a seasonally ​adjusted 197,000 for the week ended September 19, the Labor Department said on ‌Thursday. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast 201,000 claims for the latest week.
